summary: Clean and famous, but too punishing for a daily: after the Big Three and Serena, a casual player's next names (Venus, Murray, Alcaraz, Sharapova, Agassi) all cost a life. A great Blitz.
reasons: Casual found 4 (Serena, Federer, Nadal, Djokovic) and lost all 5 lives on the next five guesses: Venus (7), Andy Murray (3), Alcaraz (7), Sharapova (5), Agassi (#18, 8). Sampras and Graf never got typed. A US persona also found 4 (Gauff, Osaka, Sharapova, Agassi); only a UK persona who reached Sampras early found 7.

Every famous modern name below the Big Four costs a life (also McEnroe 7, Sinner 5, Osaka 4, Gauff 2, Swiatek 6, Sabalenka 4), and none is near the cut of 14. Each shows its total, so misses teach, but they burn lives too fast. Only Billie Jean King (12) and Borg (11) feel like near misses.

The top 10 is right (Court 24, Wills Moody 19, through the 2026 US Open: Alcaraz 7, Sinner 5) and the facts are good, but four of the ten are pre-1990 women, the owner's mlb-hits problem. Kyrgios, Kournikova and subject words are free. In Blitz every major champion scores.
fixes: Debut flag: remove `debut: true` from grand-slam-titles in scripts/topics.ts, so the list enters random play and Blitz instead of waiting for a daily slot.

scripts/facts/grand-slam-titles.json, Roger Federer: "a record eight Wimbledons" -> "a men's record eight Wimbledons". Navratilova's fact on the same list says her nine are the all-time record, so the two contradict each other in the reveal.
scripts/topics.ts grand-slam-titles aliases: add "Jokovic" and "Jokovich" to Novak Djokovic. The phonetic spelling "jokovic" is not recognized now.
